evidence.locator: Results C10orf71 is a DCM causal gene; Methods human participants

limitations: Source support is not independent clinical confirmation.

Human genetics: family described as eight DCM cases includes three historical enlarged-heart reports, not eight molecularly confirmed affected relatives. Five affected and two unaffected subjects underwent WES, LOD3 reported. Four additional variants in 492 selected sporadic subjects=220 Anzhen+272 Tongji after91 known-gene diagnoses removed; no estimate of population penetrance. Parents of Wuhan proband4 unavailable.

Figure1B coding matches packets but source protein consequences differ for all three cases. Transcript .1 versus packet .2 and genome build/indel normalization remain explicit unresolved issues. Supplemental S3 uses NP_001128668.1, same protein accession as packets, so transcript-version change alone is not a proven explanation.

Table1/Methods inconsistency: childhood probands1/2 EF50% and LVIDd4.30/4.80cm are called DCM despite definition EF<50%; TableS1 distinguishes enlarged-heart children. Anzhen 106 children include37DCM/69enlarged-heart by S1 counts,114adultDCM; not220 strict-DCM subjects.

Endogenous expression assays use different engineered early frameshifts (homo c173dupA/c172_182del and hetero c164_173del), not the exact patients variants. Lower RNA is consistent with loss of function but does not directly demonstrate NMD without inhibition/decay measurement; intronless coding exon and truncated proteins from plasmids leave mechanistic uncertainty.

Intrinsic disorder is predicted, not experimentally structurally established; expression is also high in skeletal muscle. No direct nuclear transcription mechanism or specific binding partner validation. Common-SNP LD in CHB near C10orf71 does not exclude all linked rare/noncoding causes in the Puerto Rican family.

Mice: embryo12KO with6abnormal (5noncompaction+1hypertrophic); no noncompaction after birth suggests but does not directly track individual mortality. Weaning157WT/125Het/44KO among326 versus1:2:1. Adult survivors show progressive systolic failure; survivorship selection limits extrapolation.

RNAseq embryo DEGs use nominal P<0.1 and fold0.8/1.2; adults P<0.05 and fold0.9/1.1, not stated FDR thresholds. GO Padj differs from gene-level filtering. EmbryoRNA pools3hearts each; tissue composition/remodeling and some region/cell-level replicates limit causal transcriptomic interpretation.

ATAC Methods state human GRCh38 despite experiments in embryonic mouse hearts; TableS4 ENSMUST/mouse chromosomes and mainFig5 indicate mouse results. This is an unresolved methods reporting discrepancy, not proof experiments aligned to wrong genome. Collagenase0.6g/mL printed in Methods is another suspect unit not silently repaired.

No-change significance is not equivalence: excitation-contraction delay nonsignificance does not establish all electrophysiology normal. Figure4F eight-month SV and LVPWs are NS, contrary to unqualified reduction wording. Figure7F fourteen-day LVPWs is NS despite text claiming increase at7and14days.

OM0.25mg/kg/hour continuous pump14days improves mouseEF/FS; randomized treatment and genotype-blinded echo stated. No exact human variant rescue, human treatment, long-term survival endpoint or comparative therapeutic superiority established. Treatment-blinding/vehicle details not fully explicit. Omecamtiv response does not establish benefit of arimoclomol or BubR1 rescue.

Statistics says n<=6 nonparametric, but some small-n mainfigures specify t-tests. Multiple timepoint t-tests and numerous outcomes; no general multiplicity correction described. Figure3 region-level dots are not independent mice. Original-gel labels5N/O are stale relative to final5J/K; Table5 final adjustedP missing.

Supplemental text complete, selected source-relevant pixels only; remaining supplemental figures/table pixels, four movies and data workbook unread. GEO raw data and linked references not reanalysed. This is post-inference source review, not reproduced experiments.
